acceptanceCriteria: A test with an ignored embedded or testdata file the graph reads makes `affected --path` refuse or report UNKNOWN; no plan is BOUNDED over it.
body: Residual from V1-2044 (PR #1316, AFP-V0-094) review fix. `corvint affected --path` refuses unsupported-affected-mixed-worktree when a listed path or a graph unit source/test is an ignored untracked file, but an ignored file the graph reaches through go:embed, testdata or declared read scopes is not compared, so the plan can still be BOUNDED while it depends on content absent from HEAD. Expected: refuse or widen to UNKNOWN for any ignored file the graph depends on.
title: affected --path ignored-file refusal checks unit sources and tests only, not embeds, testdata or read scopes
